name: twilio
description: Experimental: manage Twilio subaccounts, API keys, phone-number webhooks, TwiML applications, messaging services and Verify services as infrastructure with Pulumi.

nodejs.packageDescription: Experimental: manage Twilio subaccounts, API keys, phone-number webhooks, TwiML applications, messaging services and Verify services as infrastructure with Pulumi.

accountSid.description: The SID (AC...) of the Twilio account that owns the resources. Required. Falls back to the TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID environment variable.

apiKey.description: An API key SID (SK...) to authenticate with instead of the auth token; requires apiSecret. Falls back to the TWILIO_API_KEY environment variable. A restricted key cannot manage Subaccount or ApiKey resources.

apiSecret.description: The secret of apiKey. Falls back to the TWILIO_API_SECRET environment variable.

authToken.description: The account auth token. Use either authToken or apiKey with apiSecret. Falls back to the TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable.

baseUrl.description: Override for every Twilio host (requests go to <baseUrl>/<product>/<path>). Intended for testing against a mock server. Falls back to TWILIO_BASE_URL.

edge.description: Twilio edge location, for example sydney or dublin. Falls back to TWILIO_EDGE.

region.description: Twilio region for data residency, for example au1 or ie1. Falls back to TWILIO_REGION.

accountSid.description: SID of the account or subaccount that owns the number. Defaults to the provider account. twilio:index:ApiKey.description: A Twilio API key. The secret is available only in the creation response and is stored as a Pulumi secret. Creating and deleting keys requires the account auth token (an API key cannot manage keys).

accountSid.description: SID of the account or subaccount the key belongs to. Defaults to the provider account. Changing it replaces the resource. To import a key owned by a subaccount use the ID <accountSid>/<keySid>.

friendlyName.description: Human-readable name of the key (up to 64 characters).

keyType.description: standard (default; full access to the account's REST API except account and key management) or restricted (limited to the permissions in policy). Changing it replaces the resource.

policy.description: JSON policy document for a restricted key, for example {"allow":["/v1/Services/**"]}. Required when keyType is restricted and not allowed otherwise. Updated in place and read back on refresh, so a policy widened outside Pulumi is detected and reverted.

secret.description: The API key secret. Twilio returns it only once, at creation, so it cannot be recovered later or after import.

sid.description: The API key SID (SK...); use it as the username with the secret.
